Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of the underlying currency specific amounts and ratios used in the pay-in schedule calculation.

ShortPositionLimit.name: Short Position Limit
ShortPositionLimit.definition: Maximum allowed short position in the currency during settlement.

MinimumPayInAmount.name: Minimum Pay In Amount
MinimumPayInAmount.definition: Minimum amount paid in one payment unless the short position is less than the minimum.

VolatilityMargin.name: Volatility Margin
VolatilityMargin.definition: Margin used to decrease long positions and increase short positions during the risk calculation.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Exchange rate used in the calculation of the pay-in schedule.
